name: vscode-outou
description: Language support for Outou (.rsx): a TextMate grammar plus a development-only language client for outou-lsp. Not published.

outou.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `outou-lsp` binary. Empty: look for `target/debug/outou-lsp` (then `target/release`) in the repository this extension lives in, then in the ancestors of the workspace folder. A relative path is resolved against each workspace folder.

outou.trace.server.markdownDescription: Verbosity of the LSP traffic trace in the Outou Language Server output channel. The trace is only emitted while that channel's log level is `Trace` (command: `Developer: Set Log Level...`, or the gear icon in the Output panel); this setting then picks `messages` or `verbose`.
